mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1900 units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1900, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields in equities.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined signal of a tight labor market and strong job growth predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock performance
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month, indicating strong supply chain activity, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as manufacturers' growth boosts overall economic activity.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO growth > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annualized growth rate (GDPC1) below 2%, signaling sluggish demand, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors become risk-averse in anticipation of an economic slowdown.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP growth and stock market performance
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth is below 2% annually, the combined signal of tight monetary policy and low inflation predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the real interest rate attracts investors to equities.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on signal: the unemployment rate (UNRATE) being below the historical average (around 5.5%) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as a strong labor market supports consumer spending and economic growth.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market and stock performance
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE < 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% in a month, indicating robust consumer demand, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as strong retail activity boosts overall economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when RSAFS growth > 5%.
